judgments.rationale: The proposal modifies the summary and context quotes to incorporate paragraph (5)'s general limitation on civil litigation materials. However, that limitation is already retained as a separate record (C0007). Under the governing instructions, a condition retained in another record is not to be incorporated into this statement, making the edit unnecessary.

The draft reading for C0000 is independently complete, accurately reflecting the statutory requirement in subsection (d)(1) without omitting required conditions or misrepresenting the discretionary written statement exception for accompanying persons. Leaving it unchanged is correct.

The edit inaccurately converts a discretionary agency option regarding accompanying persons ('except that the agency may require the individual to furnish a written statement authorizing discussion of that individual’s record in the accompanying person’s presence') into a mandatory requirement applicable to all individuals whether accompanied or unaccompanied. It also unnecessarily imports paragraph (5), which is already retained in another record.

source_spans.quote: (d) Access to Records.— Each agency that maintains a system of rec­ords shall—

(1) upon request by any individual to gain access to his record or to any information pertaining to him which is contained in the system, permit him and upon his request, a person of his own choosing to accompany him, to review the record and have a copy made of all or any portion thereof in a form comprehensible to him, except that the agency may require the individual to furnish a written statement authorizing discussion of that individual’s record in the accompanying person’s presence;
(5) nothing in this section shall allow an individual access to any information compiled in reasonable anticipation of a civil action or proceeding.
